one_liner: LiveAgent helpdesk has a documented REST API v3 with admin-generated API keys, a 30-day free trial with no credit card, and a vendor-built MCP server (Business plan and up).
auth_notes: The REST API v3 uses a static API key that an admin generates under Configuration > System > API. This was not re-verified in the supplied pages, so the draft evidence is kept. OAuth 2.1 (Authorization Code + PKCE) and bearer tokens are documented only for the MCP server, not the main REST API.
access_notes: A 30-day free trial with no credit card is available, and the docs recommend a trial account for API testing. No permanent free tier is shown. Correction to the draft: the pricing page lists the MCP server under the Business plan, not Enterprise, and Business has a self-serve "Start free trial" button. Enterprise is "Talk to sales". Whether the trial includes the Business-tier MCP server is not stated.
blocker_notes: A 30-day no-card trial is long enough to build and test the REST API. Each customer has its own domain and API key, which is not counted as friction under the rubric.

evidence.quote: While logged in as an admin navigate to Configuration> System> API which loads the API v3 section where you find existing API keys or add a new one.
There are two ways to authenticate your MCP client - **OAuth 2.1 (recommended)**, where the AI tool discovers the authorization server automatically
Connect your support email and website chat, and answer real customers for 30 days. No credit card, no setup fee.
Consider registering a new [free Trial account](https://www.liveagent.com/trial/) for testing purposes, before using API with your live account.
